rootCauseAnalysis.symptom: Antigravity provider health degraded, Gemini candidate quota unknown, effectiveRemainingRatio 1.0
rootCauseAnalysis.rootCause: Timeout parameter mismatch. 9Router's /api/usage/[connectionId] endpoint invokes Google Cloud Code Assist upstream APIs (loadCodeAssist and quotaSummaryApiUrl) taking 1100ms - 1800ms. AutoRouter default timeout was 1000ms. AbortSignal.timeout(1000) aborted the fetch, the catch block marked Antigravity degraded, and no buckets were populated. Zero buckets caused evaluateCandidateQuota to fail-open to unknown with ratio 1.0.
rootCauseAnalysis.telemetryVsHealth: Provider connection in 9Router was healthy (testStatus active). Telemetry fetch timeout was incorrectly treated as provider degradation rather than isolated telemetry retry/degraded warning.
fixesApplied: Normalized live Antigravity schema into shared gemini_flash_pro and gemini_weekly buckets
Mapped ag/gemini-3.8-flash-low, ag/gemini-3.8-flash-medium, ag/gemini-3.8-flash-high to shared multi-window Gemini group
Separated provider API health from telemetry failure, ensuring unknown fail-open robustness

schema.quotas: Record<string, { used: number, total: number, remaining?: number, remainingPercentage?: number, resetAt?: string, unlimited?: boolean, displayName?: string }>

quotaSourceSpecification.semantics: remainingPercentage / 100 defines remainingRatio. Effective remaining is the minimum across applicable windows.
quotaSourceSpecification.resetAtSemantics: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of quota reset window

sharedGeminiQuotaGroup.factualFinding: All Gemini Flash and Pro models in Antigravity return identical usage and resetAt, verifying they draw from a single shared Google Cloud Code Assist quota pool.

thresholdReview.evaluatedStability: Confirmed sound. At 9.24% remaining, Gemini stably settles in 'reserve' without flapping. Exit threshold to conserve requires >13% remaining.

pollingLoadReview.upstreamCacheBehavior: 9Router caches weekly summary for 180s, but per-model calls hit Google Cloud Code Assist. 30s polling interval reduces upstream calls by 33% (120 calls/hr vs 180 calls/hr) preventing Google API 429 rate limit pressure.

autoReadinessGate.summary: Telemetry mapping is highly accurate and fail-open works reliably. However, the candidate pool under low Gemini (~9.2% reserve) is severely restricted: Terra (strong/high-cost) is the sole enabled non-Gemini alternative. In auto mode, 82% of all traffic would divert to Terra, which itself relies on Codex Weekly currently at 22% (conserve). This would rapidly drain Codex quota and cause cascading router exhaustion.
blockingPrerequisites: Enable a calibrated cheap/balanced non-Gemini alternative (e.g. Sol or Astra) before cutover to absorb routine low-tier requests without overloading Terra
Allow Gemini quota reset window (2026-09-18T07:36:38.000Z) to restore Flash/Pro reserve to healthy levels
Enforce routine-escalation guardrail preventing cheap routine tasks from diverting to strong tier when alternate provider is also <= 30%
